class JSONHighlighter(RegexHighlighter):
    """Highlights JSON"""

    # Captures the start and end of JSON strings, handling escaped quotes
    JSON_STR = r"(?<![\\\w])(?P<str>b?\".*?(?<!\\)\")"
    JSON_WHITESPACE = {" ", "\n", "\r", "\t"}

    base_style = "json."
    highlights = [
        _combine_regex(
            r"(?P<brace>[\{\[\(\)\]\}])",
            r"\b(?P<bool_true>true)\b|\b(?P<bool_false>false)\b|\b(?P<null>null)\b",
            r"(?P<number>(?<!\w)\-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*(e[\-\+]?\d+?)?\b|0x[0-9a-fA-F]*)",
            JSON_STR,
        ),
    ]

    def highlight(self, text: Text) -> None:
        super().highlight(text)

        # Additional work to handle highlighting JSON keys
        plain = text.plain
        append = text.spans.append
        whitespace = self.JSON_WHITESPACE
        for match in re.finditer(self.JSON_STR, plain):
            start, end = match.span()
            cursor = end
            while cursor < len(plain):
                char = plain[cursor]
                cursor += 1
                if char == ":":
                    append(Span(start, end, "json.key"))
                elif char in whitespace:
                    continue
                break

The issue is that the `@` character is not included in the `ReprHighlighter` URL regex pattern, which causes hyperlinks containing `@` (e.g., for basic authentication) to break highlighting.

FILES:
- `rich/highlighter.py`: Modify the `url` regex pattern in `ReprHighlighter.highlights`.
- `tests/test_highlighter.py`: Add a test case to `highlight_tests` to verify URLs with `@` are highlighted correctly.

ROOT CAUSE:
The URL regular expression in `ReprHighlighter` (`r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)"`) lacks the `@` character in its allowed character set, causing it to stop matching when it encounters an `@` symbol.

CHANGE:
1. In `rich/highlighter.py`, update the `url` regex to: `r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!@`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)"`.
2. In `tests/test_highlighter.py`, add `(" https://user:pass@example.org ", [Span(1, 28, "repr.url")])` to the `highlight_tests` list.

Run `pytest tests/test_highlighter.py`.
